title: The KU Leuven ASEAN Scholarship
field: Master's programmes (eligible list published by KU Leuven)
about: KU Leuven invites applicants from ASEAN countries to apply for The KU Leuven ASEAN Scholarship for an eligible master's programme starting in 2027-2028. Candidates submit a programme application and register their scholarship candidacy online.
requirements: Complete application for an eligible KU Leuven master's programme
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for The KU Leuven ASEAN Scholarship at KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium, deadline 15 Jan 2027. The background photo shows the steel spheres of the Atomium in Brussels against a cloudy sky.
